questions.4.question.source: In a made-up village, older weavers show young people how to make baskets. Later, the young people will teach others. Which word from Lesson 17 names this?
questions.4.question.back: In a fictional village, older weavers teach young people to weave baskets. Later the young people will teach others. Which word from Lesson 17 names this?
questions.4.question.note: "weavers ... baskets" as ช่างสาน ... สานตะกร้า (basket-making is สาน, not ทอ). "young people" as คนหนุ่มสาว.

questions.4.options.0.feedback.source: Not quite. A celebration marks a special day with others. Here, older people pass a skill to younger people. Look back at Lesson 17.
questions.4.options.0.feedback.back: Not quite. Celebrating is marking a special day with others. Here, older people pass a skill to younger people. Go back to Lesson 17.

questions.4.options.1.feedback.source: Yes. Transmission means passing knowledge or skills from one person to another. The weavers pass on their skill.
questions.4.options.1.feedback.back: Correct. Transmission is passing knowledge or a skill from one person to another. The weavers pass on their skill.
